description: Prescreened card email that omits the opt-out notice.
content:
Subject: You've been selected

Dear Taylor,

You've been selected! Based on information from your credit report, you were prescreened for the ClearPath Cash Back Card. If you apply and meet our criteria, you will receive a firm offer of credit.

Earn 1.5% cash back on every purchase. Learn more at clearpath.example/card. Terms apply.

ClearPath Financial, 400 Market Street, Suite 900, San Francisco, CA 94111
To stop receiving marketing emails, unsubscribe here: https://clearpath.example/unsubscribe
notes: A genuine prescreened offer, so 'selected' is not an FCRA-PREQUAL problem, but it lacks the prescreen opt-out notice. The email unsubscribe is for marketing emails, not the consumer-reporting-agency opt-out.
